permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: VoxBar needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.
microphone.deniedGuidance: No microphone access yet. Enable VoxBar under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone, then check again.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

onboarding.hotkeyChangeHint: You can change this shortcut in Settings > General.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: VoxBar Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

delete_last_word.name: Delete Last Word
delete_last_word.description: Removes the last word from the live dictation transcript while a recording session is active; does nothing otherwise. Assign a key to enable it.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: While a dictation is live: clears it (start over). Does nothing otherwise.

transcribe_commands.name: Command Mode
transcribe_commands.description: Hold this key while a dictation session is live to switch it into command interpretation: everything you say edits the dictation buffer directly (question mark, full stop or period, comma, new line, new paragraph, delete word, delete line) and unrecognized words are discarded. Release it to return to normal dictation; the final paste delivers exactly the edited buffer. It never starts a recording and does nothing on its own. Unbound by default.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Shortcut Behavior
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

deleteLastWord.title: Delete Last Word Action
deleteLastWord.description: Enable the assignable hotkey that removes the last word from the live dictation transcript while a recording session is active.

undo.title: Undo Action
undo.description: Enable the assignable hotkey that clears the live dictation transcript and starts over while a recording session is active.

toggle.title: Command Mode
toggle.description: Enable the assignable command-mode modifier key. Hold it while a dictation session is live to interpret your speech as commands (question mark, full stop or period, comma, new line, new paragraph, delete word, delete line) that edit the dictation buffer directly; unrecognized words are discarded. It never starts a recording on its own.

commands.duplicateError: The phrase "{{phrase}}" already exists on a command
commands.resetAllConfirmBody: Every custom phrase is discarded and all commands return to their built-in phrases.

actions.undo: Runs undo in the focused app
actions.paste: Pastes the clipboard in the focused app

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside VoxBar

addFromHf.title: Add model from Hugging Face
addFromHf.description: Paste a public repo URL or owner/repo, for example https://huggingface.co/owner/repo.

status.added: Model added. It appears under Downloaded Models.

errors.invalidInput: Could not read that as a Hugging Face repo: {{detail}}
errors.notFound: Repository {{repo}} was not found on Hugging Face.
errors.inaccessible: {{repo}} could not be reached on Hugging Face. It may not exist, or it may be private or gated. Only public repositories are supported for now.
errors.unsupportedArch: The model architecture {{arch}} is not supported. Supported: {{supported}}.
errors.unsupportedArchUnknown: That file could not be read as a GGUF model, so it was not added.

selectionErrors.notAsrModel: This model is the local post-process engine. It polishes transcripts after dictation, it cannot transcribe audio.
selectionErrors.generic: Could not switch to this model: {{error}}

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

memoryPressureGuard.label: Memory Pressure Guard
memoryPressureGuard.description: Refuse to load a model when free memory cannot fit it. The current model keeps working when a load is refused.

memoryHeadroom.label: Memory Safety Margin
memoryHeadroom.description: Extra free RAM kept beyond the model's size before the memory guard refuses a load. 0 (default) means the model alone must fit; a custom value is 0 or at least 5 MB.

autoFallback.label: RAM Auto-Fallback
autoFallback.description: When the selected model does not fit free memory, automatically load the best downloaded model that does. Turn off to keep the plain refusal.

menuBarModelTitle.label: Menu-Bar Model Title
menuBarModelTitle.description: Show the resident model and its RAM footprint as text next to the tray icon (macOS menu bar).

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start VoxBar when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the VoxBar icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only - look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A-Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

autoInterpret.title: Auto-Interpret Commands
autoInterpret.description: Interprets spoken command words ("comma", "scratch that") during normal dictation. Turn off to type command words as plain words; hold the command-mode modifier to enact commands.

spokenPunctuation.title: Spoken Punctuation
spokenPunctuation.description: Turns spoken punctuation words like "comma", "period" and "question mark" into real punctuation. Turn off to keep them as plain words.

terminalPunctuation.title: Terminal Punctuation
terminalPunctuation.description: Ends every transcript with punctuation: a question mark for questions, a period otherwise. Turn off to leave endings as transcribed.

voiceDeletion.title: Voice Deletion Commands
voiceDeletion.description: "scratch that", "delete that" and "remove that" delete the previous word, "delete last three words" deletes several, and "delete everything" or "start over" clears the dictation. Turn off to keep these as plain words.

previewBeforePaste.title: Preview Before Paste
previewBeforePaste.description: Briefly shows the finished transcription in the recording overlay before it is pasted. Turn off to paste immediately.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

numberFormat.title: Spoken Numbers
numberFormat.description: Writes spoken number words as digits, so "one eight zero one" pastes as 1801. As Transcribed keeps numbers as spoken; Smart also converts compound ordinals and lone numbers from eleven up.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

timeout.title: Request timeout
timeout.description: How long a cloud post-process request may run before it gives up and the raw transcript is used. Applies when an endpoint stops responding.

verdict.okNoModel: Auth OK, {{latencyMs}} ms. No model selected to test.
verdict.localReady: Local model is downloaded and ready
verdict.appleUnavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device

local.label: Local Model
local.deleteInUse: Cannot delete right now: a post-process run is in progress. Try again in a moment.

models.title: Post-process Models
models.description: The local models that clean up your transcripts. Smaller models load faster; larger ones polish better.
models.noMatch: No post-process models match your search.

addFromHf.title: Add post-process model from Hugging Face
addFromHf.description: Paste a public repo URL or owner/repo. Language-model GGUFs (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Phi) can be added.
addFromHf.added: Model added. It appears under Downloaded.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

showModel.label: Show Model Badge
showModel.description: Show a compact badge with the model that produced each transcription.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Show the Check for Updates option in the tray menu and footer

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

streamingTail.title: Streaming Release Tail
streamingTail.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) a streaming session keeps recording after you release the key, so the end of the last word is captured. 0 = no extra tail.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach VoxBar. Only event counts are recorded - never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events - keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events - something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching VoxBar normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured - did you press any keys during the test?

ppRuns.title: Post-process runs
ppRuns.description: The most recent polishing runs: engine, prompt, latency, and outcome. Copy a run's log lines for diagnostics.

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after VoxBar updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where VoxBar stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: VoxBar's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

updatePolicy.title: Update policy
updatePolicy.description: Choose what the automatic check may do when it finds an update.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder - your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder - your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.
errors.noModelSelected: Pick a transcription model in Settings before dictating.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the VoxBar interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether VoxBar follows your system theme or stays light or dark

accentColor.label: Accent Color
accentColor.description: Choose the color used for highlights, toggles, and controls

notice.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. The recording was kept, retry it from History.
notice.generic: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
notice.deleteLastWordNoSession: Delete word works during a live dictation. Start recording first.
notice.deleteLastWordNoBuffer: Nothing to delete yet, the dictation has no live text.
notice.undoNoSession: Undo works during a live dictation. Start recording first.
notice.undoNoBuffer: Nothing to clear yet, the dictation has no live text.
notice.bindingBusy: Another dictation key is already recording.
notice.waylandTauriHotkeys: Global shortcuts may not work in native Wayland apps with this keyboard backend. Switch Keyboard implementation to VoxBar Keys and add your user to the input group; see the Ubuntu troubleshooting guide.
notice.gnomeOverlayFallback: On GNOME Wayland the overlay appears as a regular window that can steal focus and break pasting. Overlay: None is recommended here.
notice.postProcessOutputInvalid: Polishing returned unusable text, so the raw transcript was kept.
notice.postProcessCloudFailed: Polishing failed and the raw transcript was kept: {{detail}}

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now - macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

postProcessSkip.memoryGate: Post-processing skipped to protect system memory. {{detail}}
postProcessSkip.downloadMissing: Post-processing skipped: the local model is not downloaded yet. Open Settings to download it.
postProcessSkip.engineFailed: Post-processing skipped: the local model could not process this transcript. The raw transcript was used.
postProcessSkip.timeout: Post-processing skipped: the local model took too long. The raw transcript was used.
postProcessSkip.lengthGuard: Post-processing skipped: the local model output failed the length check. The raw transcript was used.
postProcessSkip.tooLong: Post-processing skipped: this transcript is too long for the local model. The raw transcript was used.

postProcessFailure.auth: Polishing failed: the provider rejected the API key. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.network: Polishing failed: the provider could not be reached. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.timeout: Polishing failed: the provider took too long. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.contextLength: Polishing failed: the transcript exceeds the model's context window. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.outputInvalid: Polishing failed: the model returned unusable text. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.oom: Polishing failed: not enough memory. The raw transcript was pasted.
postProcessFailure.cancelled: Polishing was cancelled. The raw transcript was pasted.

app.translocatedTitle: VoxBar cannot install updates from this location
app.translocatedDescription: VoxBar is running from a temporary read-only location (macOS App Translocation). Quit VoxBar, drag it from your Downloads folder into Applications, and open it from there.
app.commandNoSession: The command key works while a dictation is live. Start recording first, then hold it and speak the command.
